name: Shirase Rikka
source:
“You’re just going to tell me to fix my twisted personality, aren’t you?”

A heroine so excessively tsundere that she is all but guaranteed to miss her chance at marriage if things continue this way.

She is highly guarded around men and often comes across as cold or dismissive without meaning to.

Though she appears cool and composed, she is fiercely competitive at heart-and has a clumsy side as well.

A notorious troublemaker who has even been blacklisted by a major dating consultation agency.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3862740/]Steam[/url]]
